Data:Assam.sweetened.json.Label: Deep-Sweetened Assam (Pot)
Data:Assam.sweetened.json.Desc: Sweetened with agave syrup and deep history.

Data:Assistance.barber.json.label: Barber's Assistance
Data:Assistance.barber.json.desc: The itinerant barbers of the south country will keep you clean and kempt, make sure you don't miss out on any news or gossip, and arrange matters so you aren't too troubled by vermin. Snip snip.

Data:Assistance.blacksmith.json.label: Blacksmith's Assistance
Data:Assistance.blacksmith.json.desc: Denzil the blacksmith will lend me his strength for the day. [Make use of the Blacksmith's help before dawn.]

Data:Assistance.coffinmaker.json.label: Coffinmaker's Assistance
Data:Assistance.coffinmaker.json.desc: A tamer of trees, a worker of woods, a consigner of cadavers. He has also been known to try his hand, very diffidently, at poetry. [Make use of the Coffinmaker's help before dawn.]

Data:Assistance.engineer.json.label: Consulting Engineer's Assistance
Data:Assistance.engineer.json.desc: A consulting engineer can find plenty of work in the mines and towns of the region. But Hush House represents an unusual and interesting challenge.

Data:Assistance.fisherman.intro.json.label: Fisherman's Assistance
Data:Assistance.fisherman.intro.json.desc: A fisherman from Brancrug village! He can guide me up the cliff path - if he trusts me. [The Aspects below tell you more about how and where you can use this card. Mouse over them to learn more - or to see what other things also have these Aspects.]
Data:Assistance.fisherman.intro.json.comments: Variant, so we don't want to inherit the usual from the proto

slots.label: A name?
slots.description: Is there someone who might vouch for me with the villagers?

Data:Assistance.fisherman.json.label: Fisherman's Assistance
Data:Assistance.fisherman.json.desc: Fishermen in this part of the world have a reputation as smugglers, and worse than smugglers. Those days are past, mostly, and mostly they just catch pilchards now. But they still remember the words spoken in silence to the Moon and the Sea.

Data:Assistance.fugitive.json.label: Fugitive's Assistance
Data:Assistance.fugitive.json.desc: 'Hold your noise!' called a terrible voice, as a man started up from among the graves at the side of the church porch. [...] A fearful man, all in coarse grey, with a great iron on his leg. A man with no hat, and with broken shoes, and with an old rag tied around his head.' - Dickens

Data:Assistance.json.label: Assistance
Data:Assistance.json.desc: The Librarian lives alone. But there's no shame in seeking assistance from others. [Assistance can open new rooms or help with your studies. It disappears when used, or at dawn.]

Data:Assistance.midwife.json.label: Midwife's Assistance
Data:Assistance.midwife.json.desc: As somber as autumn, as kind as autumn. She also likes her beer. [Make use of the Midwife's help before dawn.]

Data:Assistance.miner.json.label: Miner's Assistance
Data:Assistance.miner.json.desc: 'Thus they more or less ruled themselves, with the help of their wild Celtic temperament, made wilder by the hardness of their lives and the truly ghastly conditions under which they worked [...] with all this it is not to be wondered that the tinners acquired the reputation of being scarcely human. But it must be remembered that among them at all times were those whose characters could stand comparison with the best of men.' - L. Russell Muirhead

Data:Assistance.musician.json.label: Travelling Musician's Assistance
Data:Assistance.musician.json.desc: 'I'm just some irritating, lying, ginger kid from Cornwall who should have been locked up [...] I just managed to escape and blag it into music.' - Richard James

Data:Assistance.nun.json.label: Nun's Assistance
Data:Assistance.nun.json.desc: The Sisters of the Triple Knot are long gone from this corner of the world... aren't they?

Data:Assistance.orchardkeeper.json.label: Orchard-Keeper's Assistance
Data:Assistance.orchardkeeper.json.desc: 'In Cornwall, it is quite possible to take a stride from the richest vegetation into the abomination of desolation. It has been said in mockery that Cornwall does not grow wood enough to make coffins for the people.' - Sabine Baring-Gould

Data:Assistance.painter.json.label: Surrealist Painter's Assistance
Data:Assistance.painter.json.desc: What painter worth their pigments wouldn't want to spend a day at Hush House?

Data:Assistance.poet.json.label: Elegiac Poet's Assistance
Data:Assistance.poet.json.desc: Poets, they say, never do the washing up. This one hasn't brushed his hair either. But he has his uses and his talents.

Data:Assistance.rector.json.label: Rector's Assistance
Data:Assistance.rector.json.desc: Reverend Timothy, Rector of Brancrug, ordained by the Church of the Unconquered Sun. A learned man, blessed in the Tally, the Gate, and the Light. [Make use of the Rector's help before dawn.]

Data:Astrolabe.sky.json.Label: Baron Silence's Astrolabe
Data:Astrolabe.sky.json.Desc: Thomas Dewulf used this armillary - a spherical astrolabe - in his calculations, but it's much older than he was.

xexts.scrutiny: The base is marked with the wave-and-bell of the proscribed city, Ys…
The tree, the sea, then nothing.

Data:Auntmopsy.json.label: Aunt Mopsy
Data:Auntmopsy.json.desc: Collector of proverbs, connoisseur of wines, herald of the Hour called Mare-in-the-Tree.

Data:Avenue.enquiry.json.label: Avenue of Enquiry
Data:Avenue.enquiry.json.desc: A recourse that a wise Librarian might employ only as a versatile memory. There is an alternative. [Great Ink of Power; handy Soul element; incaution; readiness; blank writing medium; Inquiry via this Avenue. Wise? Absence is true skill.]

Data:Awakened.feather.json.Label: Awakened Feather
Data:Awakened.feather.json.Desc: Alive to every draught and spark.

xexts.scrutiny: Something on the wind… [There are Prentice-level Sky recipes which can create one of these.]

Data:Axe.aspect.xenodice.json.Label: Aspect of the Axe: Xenodice Half-Faced
Data:Axe.aspect.xenodice.json.Desc: One of the more enigmatic aspects of the Horned-Axe: Xenodice Half-Faced, who welcomes or slays strangers at the threshold. Xenodice is sister sometimes to owl and cat, sometimes to bull and butterfly, sometimes to dove and serpent. This hybrid nature suggests a link with the prehuman Carapace Cross - but that's not so surprising in a Name of the Axe.

Data:Azita.json.label: Ms Azita Bukhara
Data:Azita.json.desc: Businesswoman, chess-master, initiate of the scarred Hour sometimes called the Colonel.

xexts.befriend．azita．yvette: There's something between Azita and Yvette, although exactly what remains to be seen.

Data:Azita.likes.yvette.json.desc: There's some sort of spark between Azita and Yvette.

xexts.scrutiny: Once spilt, nothing remains.  [There are Keeper-level Forge recipes that can create this with the assistance of Orichalcum, among other things.]

Data:B.birdsong.json.label: Topic: Birdsong
Data:B.birdsong.json.desc: A text on music, riddles or miscellanea.

Data:B.bosk.json.label: Topic: The Bosk
Data:B.bosk.json.desc: A text on the matters of the primaeval wood.

Data:B.horomachistry.json.label: Topic: Horomachistry
Data:B.horomachistry.json.desc: A text on the laws (and disagreements) of the Hours (and their emanations).

Data:B.hushery.json.label: Topic: Hushery
Data:B.hushery.json.desc: A text on, among other things, silence.

Data:B.illumination.json.label: Topic: Illumination
Data:B.illumination.json.desc: A text on purification of the self and its surroundings.

Data:B.ithastry.json.label: Topic: Ithastry
Data:B.ithastry.json.desc: A text on alchemy, metallurgy, pyrotechnics.
